sentence: Chatterjee et al. ask about rivals directly: one of their competitive-advantage items states that implementing AI-based customer relationship management "will help an organization to win over its competitor which has not yet implemented AI-CRM for B2B relationship management"
passage: [Chatterjee et al. (2021), p. 215] "I think that successful implementation of AI-CRM will help an organization to win over its competitor which has not yet implemented AI-CRM for B2B relationship management."

gemini.note: The sentence correctly identifies the passage as a survey item, but by omitting 'I think that' from the quote, it slightly alters the item's tone from a subjective belief to a direct prediction.
